name: Grammar Detective
description_short: Students are told exactly how many grammar errors are hiding in a short paragraph and race to find and correct all of them.
teacher_note: The only grammar activity I use that doesn't feel like homework in disguise — telling them the exact error count turns it into a real hunt instead of a guessing game. Comes with three ready-to-run paragraphs, so the first lesson needs zero prep either.
creator: Free Range Tutors
